title: Fusion reactor net power output lagged one tick behind burning plasma ignition transition
description: During verification of checkpoint 303 (burning plasma Lawson ignition and inductive MHD power generation), the reactor transitioned to BurningPlasmaIgnition, but m_fNetPowerOutputMW remained 0.0f until the subsequent simulation update tick.
root_cause: The state transition check was placed in the OhmicHeating branch, while power generation was calculated in the BurningPlasmaIgnition branch using an else if. This caused an off-by-one tick latency before power generation was dispatched.
resolution: Immediately assigned m_fNetPowerOutputMW = 250.0f and accumulated m_fTotalNetPowerMW upon successful transition into BurningPlasmaIgnition. All 307 checkpoints pass with code 0.
